---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a change to behaviour, the API, the dashboard or the deployment
title: "feat: "
labels: [enhancement]
---

**Problem** — what you cannot do today, and in which migration scenario.

**Proposal** — the behaviour you would like. If it changes the API, the state machine, the security
model or the data path, say which SDD section (docs/SDD.md) would change; the SDD is amended before
code is written.

**Alternatives considered**

**Evidence** — measurements, logs (redacted) or references that support the request.
